When a particle (or object) moves with constant velocity $u,$ the position vector at time $t$ is given by the equation

$$
r={r}_{0}+ut,
$$

where ${r}_{0}$ is the initial position vector.

In this case,

$$
{r}_{0}=3i-5j,\,u=6i+2j.
$$

Therefore, the position vector of the particle after $t=5\,\text{s}$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}r & ={r}_{0}+ut \\  & =(3i-5j)+(6i+2j)(5) \\  & =3i-5j+30i+10j \\  & =(\,33\,i+5\,j)\,\text{cm}.\end{aligned}
$$
